notes.title: Forsaken Universe Early Access 1.0 Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Forsaken Universe Early Access 1.0 has been released and is now available to play in the live branch![/h2]

If you have previously had Forsaken Universe installed, please delete the game and completely reinstall it from scratch. This will allow all the new data to be installed correctly!

This update completely changes Forsaken Universe. This update contains new features that would've never been in the old game. To put it into perspective, the old game was about 3 GBs. Now, Early Access 1.0 is just above 12GBs! So, without further ado, welcome to Forsaken Universe EA 1.0.

[u][b][h3]Known Issues[/h3][/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Second main mission doesn't give the correct objective
[*] 12SG Shotgun doesn't play the correct animations for reloading
[*] Some AI isn't able to hit your character
[*] Sometimes the exit location doesn't work when players exit the ship
[*] Game isn't fully optimized
[/list]

[u][b][h3]New Features[/h3][/b][/u]

[list]
[*] New Mission system. Basic, but working. Includes 4 starting quests.
[*] 6 new weapons including 2 pistols, 1 assault rifle, 1 shotgun, 1 sniper, and 1 grenade
[*] Flyable ship!
[*] New customization system for your character
[*] New custom AI including animals and humanoids
[*] Updated inventory
[*] Farming system
[*] Player credits
[*] Dynamic weather system including rain, snow, and dust
[*] Harvestable bodies, usually with animals
[*] And much more!
[/list]

It may seem like this update isn't that big but in reality, it is. This update gives us the base to expand the game in any way we want. Our goal is to make this game extremely unique compared to any other game and we hope you join us in this process. If you want to stay up-to-date on progress and see new features that will be coming to the game, join our discord server! We have a lot of amazing plans coming up and we hope to see you soon in the Forsaken Universe or Discord server!

Discord Server Link: https://discord.com/invite/peeveRpU8W

notes.title: Forsaken Universe Announcement 3/5/2023
notes.content:
[h1][b]Forsaken Universe Announcement 3/5/2023[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]What's the holdup![/b][/h2]
Hey everyone! First off I am going to personally apologize for disappearing for the last three months. College got a little bit hard. So with that, I am very sorry! Buttttttt, that doesn't mean I haven't been working on Forsaken Universe! The new update, Early Access 1.0, is coming along very smoothly! Lots of testing has been going into the game as well as adding some new features! This post will have three main things, what is left that needs to be added to the new update, as well as our new screenshots for the store page! AKA, some teasers for what is to come, and lastly when everything will be happening!

[h2][b]What needs to be done?[/b][/h2]
I have put together a list of what needs to be done before the official release of Early Access 1.0.
[list]
[*] Add 6 different weapons, 2 pistols, 2 assault rifles, 1 shotgun, and 1 sniper.
[*] Add 5 different quests.
[*] Add 3 more ships.
[*] Update UI to make it look more professional.
[*] Update main menu and main menu world.
[*] Update most creatures and AI.
[*] Add more locations to explore on Zoroth.
[*] Start working on the planet Drax.
[*] Fix some outstanding bugs.
[/list]
As you can see, there isn't that much left to do for Early Access, but it still will take time!

[h2][b]The Photos![/b][/h2]
We have taken some new photos of what the game looks like and added them to the store page. Well, here are some of the photos!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39511155/bcbc2801520082e118aba8d3868578545d024073.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39511155/25db488729fc8fd3e981e7f91093f81cfff10253.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39511155/2f9f725af57a87201933471334d45dac5ba67178.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39511155/5d0a07229137bdee7fcc14f1c3722955dbeaa86c.png[/img]


[h2][b]When is this all happening...[/b][/h2]
Well, with the list that needs to be done, you may think that it'll take 2-3 months with my development to get this update out... WRONG! On Sunday, 3/12/2023, I will be releasing a pre-update patch to the main branch of Forsaken Universe. This will hold everything new in the game and be playable for you! Then, the official release of the new Early Access 1.0 will be in the next month! When? I don't know yet but be on the lookout for the next announcement!

Thank you all for reading!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/uKqcjtc84e

notes.title: Forsaken Universe Announcement 12/29/2022
notes.content:
[h1][b]Forsaken Universe Announcement 12/29/2022[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Let's Begin[/b][/h2]
Hey there everyone! Just wanted to say thank you for your time and patience. With Christmas just happening and the new year coming about, I personally wish you all a Merry Christmas and a happy New Year. Now, Forsaken Universe hasn't seen an update in well, over a year and that is something I don't like. I got very busy with sports and college and had a hard time my first few semesters. My third semester came along and I finally found time to work on the game as I became acclimated to college life. With that being said, I wanted to make this announcement to inform you all about the new update!

[h2][b]The Update[/b][/h2]
With no update to the game in over a year, I am very excited to say that the update will be happening in [b]Early or Mid January[/b]! There is still a lot of work to do for the game to prepare for it! I am very excited to bring this update to you as it completely changes Forsaken Universe as a game. For example, I have added 3 different ships, 3 different planets to explore, 12 different unique creatures, 5 different weapons, quests, a level system, trading, different locations on the planets to explore, more build parts, over 60 different items, and so much more. This is what Forsaken Universe should've been when it first came out so I am extremely sorry that you didn't get this. 

[h2][b]Quick Wrap Up[/b][/h2]
With all this being said, I am very excited to bring you this new update soon, I have just released a new discord server where more leaks will be posted, you can ask questions about the new update, or just talk with me or the team! Here is the link to the discord as well as a quick video showing off our new flight system!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/uKqcjtc84e

notes.title: Forsaken Universe Update 11/17/2022
notes.content:
Hey there you all!

With college and now basketball taking up a lot of my time, I haven't had much to work on Forsaken Universe. However, that shouldn't be a problem anymore. I have freed up a lot of my time with schooling as I have finished up 2 out of my 4 classes already. This will leave time to start working harder on the game! We have a lot of different things planned for this new release of Forsaken Universe, here is just a small list of what to be expected.

- 5 above-ground biomes.
- 3 below-ground biomes.
- Over 40 crafting recipes.
- Over 30 character upgrades.
- 10 unique weapons to defend yourself from the monsters.
- 8 unique creatures with custom AI.

Sounds like just a basic survival game but after that release, there will be constant updates. We will release a dev branch of the game for everyone to play. Those dev branches can contain either weekly or every other week updates.

Thank you all for reading, be aware of the next announcement coming in December!

notes.title: Forsaken Universe Update 4/28/2022
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We would just like to create this small announcement. I'm a college student developing this game in my free time. However, the college classes have taken up a LOT of my time. I have been working on Forsaken Universe for about an hour every week with college classes. I get done with my semester in about two weeks and will start to work more on the game!

As of now, Forsaken Universe uses Unreal Engine 4 as of right now. I am going to be upgrading the game engine to Unreal Engine 5. This will allow me to have a lot more optimization as well as a bigger open world. The next update that Forsaken Universe has will not be told as it's unknown. We hope in at least 1-2 months but could be longer.

Hopefully, you all understand that college is taking up most of my time. But, we thank you for playing and being a part of this community!

notes.title: Announcement! Early Access 1.0.7
notes.content:
Announcement!
First thing, the announcement. Multiplayer will NOT be coming to the game for a while! There is localhost multiplayer which you can play the story or the regular map. If you play the story, there will be bugs with it! We will not test the story on multiplayer until we have got most of the story created. Maybe, once the official release is out, there will be official servers, but that won't be for a while. We want to focus on the story and a lot of game mechanics. This update took a while due to all the bug fixes that we have added, as well as got the background for dedicated servers working. Thank you all for playing Forsaken Universe!
Early Access 1.0.7
[b]ADDED[/b]
- Much better map widget.
- Character dialogue for the story. Still will be adding a lot more!
- More input customization
[b]FIXED[/b]
- some checks added to make sure you can't open your inventory in the creation menu, inventory menu, and vice versa.
- Bug fixes, lots and lots of them.
- Loading Screen.
[b]UPDATED[/b]
- Animal Spawning.
- Smaller minimap.
- Variants Mesh.
- Elite Mesh.
- Kraytons Mesh.
- Main Menu Universe Background.
Next update plans!
A lot and a lot of story work. Going to get a lot of the story out there. That'll basically be the next update is just a lot of story and maybe some other minor things. We also want to add the horror aspect to the game. The night part is there, but not the creatures... Please note! Click the discord icon in the main menu to access the discord and provide feedback or bugs! Those get fixed in the latest dev build right away!

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thank you for playing Forsaken Universe! We have spent a lot of time working on the story side of the game. Making the plans for the future of the game, characters, what the other planets will look like, and so much more! We have also been working on dedicated servers for multiplayer. They are being a pain. But that won't stop us. We have started planning the AI to get the game's horror aspect into play. This will not be in for a little while but will be soon! Just a lot of plans that we have worked on so we are creating this small update announcement to tell you what we have worked on! Again, thank you all for playing Forsaken Universe!
[b]ADDED[/b]
- Weapon skins now load on save load.
- Barrels around the world. Gives metal.
- Trainyard.
- Metal now spawns in crates.
[b]FIXED[/b]
- Sun shining through the ground at night.
[b]UPDATED[/b]
- Story
[b]REMOVED[/b]
- Death Sound
- Tutorial Level (Now is in the story)
[b]Next update plans![/b]
- More story line! We want to get a lot of the story out there!
- Metal Pickaxe and Axe.
- Some map work for the story.

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.5
notes.content:

[b]UPDATED[/b]

- Inventory UI.

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.3
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing Forsaken Universe! Let's continue to grow as a community! This update is all over, added, removed, updates, and fixed things. Overall, very successful with this update.
   I will no longer provide updates every day! Instead. I will update every week on the default playable branch. However, there is a developmental branch you can access on steam! That is where we will provide updates when we think it's suited(most likely every day or every other day). This is so that we and the community can test things and leave feedback about them.
   As you can see, the story is starting to be developed. The story is partially fully complete in a separate document. However, since this is early access, the story can and most likely will change!
   Again, thank you all for playing!
[b]ADDED[/b]
- Simple loading screen.
- Simple outer Elite Faction tower.
- Based upon the faction selection, the decreased attributes are now applied.
[b]FIXED[/b]
- Made "Wisely" in the story no longer capital W.
- Bread Logo is now transparent.
- Weapons Bench T1 Placement.
- Not being able to access the weapons bench at all.
- Double input for opening character creation menu.
- Double input for opening the map menu.
[b]UPDATED[/b]
- Map Widget (m).
- Trees models and trees now use up less performance.
[b]REMOVED[/b]
- "LEARN" from weapons bench T1.
- Removed M4A4 and P1911 weapons from the weapon bench. 
- Removed attributes upgrade menu.


[u][b]IMPORTANT!!!!!![/b][/u]
With all of the fixes and additions, we have added, we are going to focus on this next update on optimization with the game! Optimization will allow those players who are wanting to play the game on a lower-end PC to play! This update can take 3 days to 2 weeks, just depends on when we think we are good with it. Just a quick announcement about it and we thank you for playing Forsaken Universe Early Access!
